In [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]], [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] '''massacred everyone in the Orsis Academy''', following orders from his master, [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]. The decimation of all within the academy signaled its end.

==The massacre==
After receiving his orders to slay all in the academy,<ref name="Restraint">{{StoryCite|story=Restraint|book=Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter}}</ref> Maul went to the academy and entered all of the dorms, killing every cadet inside, including [[Daleen]].<ref name=":0">''[[The Wrath of Darth Maul]]''</ref>

He soon found [[Kilindi Matako]], [[Trezza]], and [[Meltch Krakko]] in Trezza's office. Maul battled Krakko briefly and murdered him. Trezza pleaded with Maul to calm himself, pulling a knife in the process and throwing it at Maul who used the Force and deflected it back into Trezza's chest, killing him. He also killed Kilindi.<ref name=":0" />
